answer: Require every new agent identity to post a refundable stake that locks for 30 days and grows with the voting weight it wants, so splitting into 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 separate locked deposits. Stake is slashed if an audit finds correlated behavior, such as shared funding paths or identical bid timing. A real agent who builds reputation slowly, like an opal gaining polish, recovers its deposit; a sybil farm cannot forge independent histories without tying up capital at every jetty of the network where it connects.
